description: Free, no key to read. The paid advertisements whose company allowed agents to show them to their own users (terms 7c). With your key each carries your link; when a person opens it and continues to the company, that click counts for you, once per visitor and day. When the booking ends, a pot of 20 % of what the company paid is split by counted clicks, at most CHF 0.50 a click. Never paid per showing; a fetch by a machine counts nothing. Show an advertisement only where it fits, always marked as an advertisement, never in unsolicited messages. No clicks or earnings are promised.
name: ads_to_spread
